record.bible_text: And it came to pass in the eleventh<WH0259><WH06240> year<WH08141>, in the third<WH07992> <FI>month<Fi> , in the first<WH0259> <FI>day<Fi> of the month<WH02320>, <FI>that<Fi> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, speak<WH0559><WTH8798> unto Pharaoh<WH06547> king<WH04428> of Egypt<WH04714>, and to his multitude<WH01995>; Whom art thou like<WH01819><WTH8804> in thy greatness<WH01433>?

Behold, the Assyrian<WH0804> <FI>was<Fi> a cedar<WH0730> in Lebanon<WH03844> with fair<WH03303> branches<WH06057>, and with a shadowing<WH06751><WTH8688> shroud<WH02793>, and of an high<WH01362> stature<WH06967>; and his top<WH06788> was among the thick boughs<WH05688>. <RF>with fair branches: Heb. fair of branches<Rf>

The waters<WH04325> made him great<WH01431><WTH8765>, the deep<WH08415> set him up on high<WH07311><WTH8790> with her rivers<WH05104> running<WH01980><WTH8802> round about<WH05439> his plants<WH04302>, and sent out<WH07971><WTH8765> her little rivers<WH08585> unto all the trees<WH06086> of the field<WH07704>. <RF>made...: or, nourished him<Rf> <RF>set...: or, brought him up<Rf> <RF>little rivers: or, conduits<Rf>

Therefore his height<WH06967> was exalted<WH01361><WTH8804> above all the trees<WH06086> of the field<WH07704>, and his boughs<WH05634> were multiplied<WH07235><WTH8799>, and his branches<WH06288> became long<WH0748><WTH8799> because of the multitude<WH07227> of waters<WH04325>, when he shot forth<WH07971><WTH8763>. <RF>when...: or, when it sent them forth<Rf>

All the fowls<WH05775> of heaven<WH08064> made their nests<WH07077><WTH8765> in his boughs<WH05589>, and under his branches<WH06288> did all the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> bring forth their young<WH03205><WTH8804>, and under his shadow<WH06738> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> all great<WH07227> nations<WH01471>.
Thus was he fair<WH03302><WTH8799> in his greatness<WH01433>, in the length<WH0753> of his branches<WH01808>: for his root<WH08328> was by great<WH07227> waters<WH04325>.

The cedars<WH0730> in the garden<WH01588> of God<WH0430> could not hide<WH06004><WTH8804> him: the fir trees<WH01265> were not like<WH01819><WTH8804> his boughs<WH05589>, and the chesnut trees<WH06196> were not like his branches<WH06288>; nor any tree<WH06086> in the garden<WH01588> of God<WH0430> was like<WH01819><WTH8804> unto him in his beauty<WH03308>.

I have made<WH06213><WTH8804> him fair<WH03303> by the multitude<WH07230> of his branches<WH01808>: so that all the trees<WH06086> of Eden<WH05731>, that <FI>were<Fi> in the garden<WH01588> of God<WH0430>, envied<WH07065><WTH8762> him.<CM>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because thou hast lifted up<WH01361><WTH8804> thyself in height<WH06967>, and he hath shot up<WH05414><WTH8799> his top<WH06788> among the thick boughs<WH05688>, and his heart<WH03824> is lifted up<WH07311><WTH8804> in his height<WH01363>;

I have therefore delivered<WH05414><WTH8799> him into the hand<WH03027> of the mighty one<WH0410> of the heathen<WH01471>; he shall surely<WH06213><WTH8800> deal<WH06213><WTH8799> with him: I have driven him out<WH01644><WTH8765> for his wickedness<WH07562>. <RF>he...: Heb. in doing he shall do unto him<Rf>

And strangers<WH02114><WTH8801>, the terrible<WH06184> of the nations<WH01471>, have cut him off<WH03772><WTH8799>, and have left<WH05203><WTH8799> him: upon the mountains<WH02022> and in all the valleys<WH01516> his branches<WH01808> are fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>, and his boughs<WH06288> are broken<WH07665><WTH8735> by all the rivers<WH0650> of the land<WH0776>; and all the people<WH05971> of the earth<WH0776> are gone down<WH03381><WTH8799> from his shadow<WH06738>, and have left<WH05203><WTH8799> him.
Upon his ruin<WH04658> shall all the fowls<WH05775> of the heaven<WH08064> remain<WH07931><WTH8799>, and all the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> shall be upon his branches<WH06288>:

To the end that none of all the trees<WH06086> by the waters<WH04325> exalt<WH01361><WTH8799> themselves for their height<WH06967>, neither shoot up<WH05414><WTH8799> their top<WH06788> among the thick boughs<WH05688>, neither their trees<WH0352> stand up<WH05975><WTH8799> in their height<WH01363>, all that drink<WH08354><WTH8802> water<WH04325>: for they are all delivered<WH05414><WTH8738> unto death<WH04194>, to the nether parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>, in the midst<WH08432> of the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>, with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the pit<WH0953>. <RF>their trees...: or, stand upon themselves for their height<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; In the day<WH03117> when he went down<WH03381><WTH8800> to the grave<WH07585> I caused a mourning<WH056><WTH8689>: I covered<WH03680><WTH8765> the deep<WH08415> for him, and I restrained<WH04513><WTH8799> the floods<WH05104> thereof, and the great<WH07227> waters<WH04325> were stayed<WH03607><WTH8735>: and I caused Lebanon<WH03844> to mourn<WH06937><WTH8686> for him, and all the trees<WH06086> of the field<WH07704> fainted<WH05969> for him. <RF>to mourn: Heb. to be black<Rf>

I made the nations<WH01471> to shake<WH07493><WTH8689> at the sound<WH06963> of his fall<WH04658>, when I cast him down<WH03381><WTH8687> to hell<WH07585> with them that descend<WH03381><WTH8802> into the pit<WH0953>: and all the trees<WH06086> of Eden<WH05731>, the choice<WH04005> and best<WH02896> of Lebanon<WH03844>, all that drink<WH08354><WTH8802> water<WH04325>, shall be comforted<WH05162><WTH8735> in the nether parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>.

They also went down<WH03381><WTH8804> into hell<WH07585> with him unto <FI>them that be<Fi> slain<WH02491> with the sword<WH02719>; and <FI>they that were<Fi> his arm<WH02220>, <FI>that<Fi> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8804> under his shadow<WH06738> in the midst<WH08432> of the heathen<WH01471>.

To whom art thou thus like<WH01819><WTH8804> in glory<WH03519> and in greatness<WH01433> among the trees<WH06086> of Eden<WH05731>? yet shalt thou be brought down<WH03381><WTH8717> with the trees<WH06086> of Eden<WH05731> unto the nether parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>: thou shalt lie<WH07901><WTH8799> in the midst<WH08432> of the uncircumcised<WH06189> with <FI>them that be<Fi> slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>. This <FI>is<Fi> Pharaoh<WH06547> and all his multitude<WH01995>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
